scripts.db:workout-write-fence:status:remote: wrangler d1 execute tres-fort-db --remote --command "SELECT enabled, activated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workout_write_permit) AS permits FROM workout_write_fence WHERE id = 1"
scripts.db:workout-write-fence:activate:remote: wrangler d1 execute tres-fort-db --remote --command "UPDATE workout_write_fence SET enabled = 1, activated_at = CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 WHERE id = 1 AND enabled = 0"
scripts.db:intervals-source-fence:status:remote: wrangler d1 execute tres-fort-db --remote --command "SELECT f.enabled, f.activated_at, f.activated_user_count, f.activated_connected_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE intervals_athlete_id IS NOT NULL) AS legacy_athletes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE intervals_cutover_athlete_id IS NOT NULL) AS shadow_athletes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE COALESCE(intervals_cutover_athlete_id, intervals_athlete_id) IS NOT NULL AND (intervals_api_key IS NOT NULL OR intervals_oauth_access_token IS NOT NULL)) AS connected_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE intervals_oauth_refresh_token IS NOT NULL) AS oauth_refresh_token_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE intervals_events_synced_at IS NOT NULL OR intervals_activities_synced_at IS NOT NULL OR intervals_events_sync_attempt <> 0 OR intervals_activities_sync_attempt <> 0) AS unreset_users FROM intervals_source_fence f WHERE f.singleton = 1"
scripts.db:intervals-source-fence:activate:remot: wrangler d1 execute tres-fort-db --remote --command "UPDATE intervals_source_fence SET enabled = 1, activated_at = CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000, activated_user_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users), activated_connected_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE intervals_athlete_id IS NOT NULL AND (intervals_api_key IS NOT NULL OR intervals_oauth_access_token IS NOT NULL)) WHERE singleton = 1 AND enabled = 0 RETURNING enabled, activated_at, activated_user_count, activated_connected_count"
scripts.release:preflight: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.release: npm run release:preflight && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy
